Alex: Quick heads-up — PR #7321 is blocking tonight's midnight release (00:30 UTC cutoff). It's the kv-cache regen stall fix + tiny schema tweak. Need 2 approvals before cutoff.
Maya: On it, can you drop the smoke run results?
Alex: sure — ran staging smoke, kv warmups + 1k req perf looked fine.
Alex: smoke snippet: `ok: kv-warmup=pass, tail-latency=45ms p95, errors=0`
Sam: pinging in — I'll review the diff now, expecting to finish in ~12m. If there's anything asyncable call it out.
Priya: QA checked the migration path on staging, no failures. Also validated canary script: `scripts/canary/run_smoke.sh` returned exit 0.
Maya: reading now. main concern is the migration roll back path; can we ensure rollback is reversible before merge?
Alex: yes — migration is idempotent and reversible, added revert SQL in the PR description.
Sam: left one inline comment about a nil-check in kv_restore.go — small change.
Alex: pushed a 1-line fix for the nil-check (force-pushed).
Maya: quick +1 from me after confirming the revert steps, will give formal LGTM in thread. :thumbsup:
Priya: LGTM from QA side — smoke and canary green.
Sam: LGTM — code comment fixed and tests pass locally.
Alex: thanks y'all. We have 2x LGTM. Planning merge at 00:08 UTC to allow a 20m smoke in prod before cutoff.
deploy-bot: Reminder — release cutover window opens 00:00 UTC, rollback window until 01:00 UTC.
Maya: I'll monitor metrics for first 10m post-merge. Ping me if any error spikes.
Priya: I'll run targeted perf probes and share dashboards.
Alex: If anything flares, revert plan: revert PR -> redeploy previous image -> confirm kv warmup.
Sam: I'll be around for fast revert if needed.
Alex: merging now. Thanks team. :rocket:
